meta.what_this_is: A per-term-in-verse LEXICAL DECOMPOSITION of the inner-being terms in the verses where cluster M14 ('Deceit, Hypocrisy and Falsehood') occurs. Each record shows what a verse says about the inner being, recorded once per term-occurrence. Mechanically derived (01b v2) over the original-language morphology; the interpretive fields (cause, location, divine_involvement, object_type, valence) are resolved by a focused verse-read API pass.
meta.structure: data = array of VERSES. Each verse = {verse:{reference,osis_id,testament,verse_text}, term_occurrences:[ {term:{strong,translit,gloss,language,cluster,focus_cluster}, verse_report:{target_word,morph,stem}, lexical:{...}} ]}.
meta.layout_fan_out: VERSE-based fan-out — each verse lists EVERY term in it, not just the focus cluster's (focus_cluster=true marks the terms of interest). A term's `compound` lists its co-terms, which are present as their OWN full records in the same verse — fan out by matching translit/gloss to analyse synergy without leaving the verse.

Fixed (_canon). This restored divine/negation/faculty/object-type detection; much of the prior 'thin' output was this bug.
engine_changes.valence: context rule added: prohibition ('al/me + 2nd/3rd-person volitive) -> forbidden (mechanical); commanded/righteous/neutral are interpretive -> verse-read. engine_changes.divine_involvement: role taxonomy: object (divine adjacent to term, or 'et-marked) is mechanical (~92%); agent/possessor/giver/addressee are read-resolved (morphologically overlapping); no divine lemma -> NONE. The old meaningless 'present' value is gone.

engine_changes.t2_noise_filter_20260620: a T2 content-word occurrence is now kept ONLY if its base Strong's serves a recognised inner-being qualifier role (seat · intensifier · faculty · perception/cognition · divine · spirit-being · inherent-valence); other T2 content (e.g. seed, hand, name) is dropped as noise from the fan-out (researcher direction).

why_each_element_is_derived._principle: Every value is DERIVED from a named original-language measure (lemma · morphology · per-occurrence STEP sense · co-occurring tagged terms) — never from the English string. 'Mechanical' = fixed by rule over the measure layer; 'read' = the verse was read by API where the rule cannot be decisive (clarify/enrich only, never an opt-out). Silence = NONE (never imputed).
why_each_element_is_derived.sense: measure: per-occurrence ESV target_word (wa_verse_records) + the lemma's medium_def (lexicon, shown as lemma_meaning). Mechanical — the sense the term carries HERE, not a uniform gloss.
why_each_element_is_derived.type: measure: part-of-speech (morphology). Rule: verb/participle->action, noun->status, adjective->quality. Mechanical (POS-only).
why_each_element_is_derived.mode: measure: morph stem/voice/form. The term's own grammatical realisation (language · POS · stem). Mechanical bedrock.
why_each_element_is_derived.faculty: measure: the TERM's own lemma meaning, classified to a faculty (R1 term-intrinsic). Why term-intrinsic: the trigger's faculty (e.g. the perception that caused fear) belongs to cause/compound, not to this term. Mechanical. (R2 = co-occurring faculty-lemma assignment is a known not-yet-implemented extension.)
why_each_element_is_derived.location: measure: a constitutional-seat lemma (Strong's seat-map: heart/soul/spirit/mind/flesh) present in the verse, SENSE-GATED for spirit/breath (ruach/pneuma may be wind/disposition, not the seat). De-duplicated per level. Mechanical floor + READ for the spirit/breath ambiguity. Absent = not located.
why_each_element_is_derived.origin: measure: a 'from'-source preposition (min/apo/ek) governing the term -> received-from-outside; else absent. Mechanical (partial — within-person/generational/giver-source rules are not yet implemented).
why_each_element_is_derived.how: measure: the governing finite verb of a NOUN/adjective term (the predicate the state operates BY, e.g. 'seized'). Mechanical. ABSENT for verb-terms — the term IS the action (see mode).
why_each_element_is_derived.object / object-type: measure: the term's governed object (noun/pronoun after the term or its governing verb; 'et marks the accusative). object-type classifies it: God/spiritual-being/person are mechanical (divine/spirit-being lemma, or person morph); thing/abstract/situation/threat are READ-classified (the mechanical 'thing/abstract' lump is split by the verse-read). ⚠ CAVEAT: the `object` TEXT is a MECHANICAL best-guess and is imprecise in ~13% of cases (it can grab a determiner/pronoun like 'every'/'his'/'the', or the addressee). `object_type` is READ-derived and AUTHORITATIVE — when the two disagree, trust `object_type` and treat `object` text as a hint only.
why_each_element_is_derived.cause: measure: a causal marker (ki/hoti/gar) -> the eliciting clause, READ-resolved to the actual cause; OR the object of a perception verb for an affect term (mechanical). Else NONE (most verses state no cause). Why read: the cause is the verse's argument, not a single lemma.
why_each_element_is_derived.cause_clause: mechanical HINT only — the raw clause after the 'because/for' marker; superseded by `cause` once read.
why_each_element_is_derived.experiencer: measure: the term's possessive-suffix person / nominative subject (morphology) -> self | other | other(addressed). Mechanical.
why_each_element_is_derived.divine_involvement: measure: a divine lemma (YHWH/Elohim/…) and its grammatical relation to the term. object (adjacent / 'et-marked) is mechanical; agent/possessor/giver/addressee are READ-resolved (these roles overlap morphologically — the role is the semantic judgement 'is God feared, acting, or giving'). No divine lemma -> NONE.
why_each_element_is_derived.intensity: measure: a quantifier/intensifier lemma modifying the term (kol 'all', me'od 'very', rab 'many'). Mechanical.
why_each_element_is_derived.valence: measure: term-inherent moral lemma + context. forbidden = a dedicated prohibition particle ('al/me) on a 2nd/3rd-person volitive (mechanical, ~80% — the 'fear not' reassurance shares the form). commanded/righteous/neutral are interpretive -> read. Corpus valence read COMPLETE (unparked 2026-06-18) — values here are READ-resolved.
why_each_element_is_derived.immediate_response: measure: the coordinated reaction verb-phrase following the term's clause (the inner being's first response). Mechanical (light). Expectation test: silent -> NONE.
why_each_element_is_derived.relational: measure: a directional preposition adjacent to the term (to/toward/against/above). Mechanical (crude — the {direction->object} pairing is a not-yet-implemented extension).
why_each_element_is_derived.compound: measure: the verse's OTHER active tagged terms (the reference's term inventory), each with its role to the head term (partner = co-T1 · qualifier = T2 · co-seated = shares a constitutional seat). This is the synergy web; fan out to each co-term's own full record by translit/gloss.

fields.sense: per-occurrence contextual sense (the ESV word used in THIS verse)
fields.type: action | status | quality — the grammatical kind (from morphology)
fields.mode: the term's grammatical realisation: language · part-of-speech · (verb stem)
fields.faculty: the inner-being faculty the TERM ITSELF engages (affect/cognition/perception/memory/volition/moral_evaluation/conscience); term-intrinsic; ABSENT if the term is not itself a faculty
fields.location: constitutional seat the state is seated in (spirit/soul/heart/mind/flesh/conscience); READ-disambiguated; absent if none
fields.how: the governing predicate — how a noun/state term operates; ABSENT for verb-terms (the term IS the action; see mode)
fields.object: what the state is directed at / acts on
fields.cause: what AROUSES the state; READ-resolved; absent = the verse states no cause
fields.cause_clause: mechanical hint only — the raw clause after a 'because/for' marker (superseded by `cause` once read)
fields.experiencer: who bears the state: self | other | other (addressed)
fields.divine_involvement: GOD's role toward the term (agent/possessor/giver/object/addressee); READ-resolved
fields.immediate_response: the immediate reaction the state produces (e.g. 'bowed faces')
fields.compound: co-occurring terms in THIS verse, each as `translit "gloss" — role` (partner/qualifier/co-seated). FAN-OUT: every co-term is present as its OWN full record in this verse's term_occurrences — resolve by matching translit/gloss
